description: This file is a shell script for building, testing, and generating coverage reports for the entservices-appgateway-34 project. It automates environment setup, repo checkout, patch application, building dependencies like Thunder, ThunderTools, googletest, and the main project components, as well as running tests and creating coverage reports.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in PATH.

methods.name: is_root
methods.description: Checks if the script is run as root.

methods.name: apt_can_run
methods.description: Checks if apt-get can be run (e.g., if in a root or sudo environment).

methods.name: apt_get
methods.description: Runs apt-get command with non-interactive options.

methods.name: run_best_effort
methods.description: Executes a command, logs failures as warnings, non-fatal.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Checks out a specific git ref in a repo.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Clones a repo if needed and checks out a specific ref.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch to a repository directory, handling already applied patches gracefully.

methods.name: build_dir_configured
methods.description: Checks if a build directory is configured (CMakeCache present).

methods.name: is_component_installed
methods.description: Heuristic to determine if a component is installed into a prefix.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a component via CMake with full install.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_noinstall
methods.description: Configures and builds a component via CMake without running install (used for non-root install/testing).

methods.name: stage_all_plugins_from_dir_best_effort
methods.description: Copies plugin files (.so) from a source directory to staging directory, best effort.
